data.action: 白手套手指抵太阳穴施展心理掌握，星瞳狡黠，从容微笑
data.camera: medium shot, elegant gesture, school courtyard, queenly poise
data.description: 【常盘台中庭·午后】女王蜂缓缓抬起雪白的手套手指，轻轻抵在太阳穴旁——那是最优雅的支配手势。星形的瞳孔里闪过狡黠的光，常盘台的中庭在她的一次眨眼间秩序井然。米色毛衣背心与灰裙勾勒出从容的仪态，手提包里的遥控器排成一列，仿佛整个学园都是她的舞台——「心理掌握，全员听我指挥哦♪」
data.lighting: 明亮校园阳光与中庭绿荫
data.promptProse: Shokuhou Misaki raises one white spider-web-printed glove to her temple in the elegant gesture of Mental Out, her star-shaped pupils glinting with playful dominance as the Tokiwadai courtyard falls into perfect order at a blink. Her beige sweater vest and grey pleated skirt carry her queenly poise, the handbag on her arm displaying its row of remote controls like a scepter, and her confident smile promises the whole academy is her stage. Medium shot, cinematic lighting, sunlight, detailed school background.
data.title: 食蜂操祈 · 心理掌握的女王仪态·「全员——听我指挥哦♪」
